newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to delay gas, electricity rate hikes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to delay gas, electricity rate hikes - paper.

text.p: Brazil's government will not authorize increases in gas, electricity and fuel prices over the next two or three months, O Globo daily said.

The newspaper said profits at state-owned firms Telebras, Petrobras and Eletrobras, which totalled 3.4 billion reais in the first half, and August deflation reinforced the Finance Ministry's favorable position to delay rate hikes.
O Globo also said the Mines and Energy Minister Raimundo Britto confirmed there will not be increases this year in fuel and electricity rates.
According to the minister, there is no need for rate increases as state firms have showed productitivy gains, the newspaper said.
Hikes in fuel, telecommunications, mail and electricity rates were expected for the end of this year.
